dogecoin.text: @IvanDamnit @elonmusk @nbcsnl SNL is a Goofy show! You expected a serious endorsement? Let loose! Elon is NOT all about Dogecoin! He runs SpaceX, Tesla, a small school, and has children to spend time with! Leave him alone about Doge and let the market do what it does! The jokes about Doge were perfect for SNL

Remember, the markets rising and falling is psychological primarily. Elon as an affective hype for Doge coin has been exhausted. The boy cried wolf too many times. Doge needs another new source of hype.
